title: Basic Clips that Work Pretty Well
text:
Basic Clips that Work Pretty Well. The Marrywindix beach towel clips are basic, plastic clips. Nothing fancy, but they do work pretty well. They expand wide enough to clip onto fairly thick items, more so than a regular sized clothespin. They come in an assortment of bright colors, but they do have a cheap look to them. They look like something you would pick up at the dollar store or other discount store. They are not particularly sturdy feeling, but they don't fall apart at first use either.

*I received these clips from Marrywindix for the purpose of trying them out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.
